description: This file defines the `Subtraction` class in the `Matrix\Operators` namespace, implementing subtraction operations on matrices or numeric values within a matrix manipulation library. It provides methods for executing subtraction with matrices or scalar values, including validation of dimensions and argument types.

classes.name: Subtraction
classes.description: Class for performing subtraction operations on matrices or scalars in the matrix library.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the subtraction operation with a matrix or numeric value, returning the object for chaining.

methods.name: subtractScalar
methods.description: Performs subtraction of a scalar value across all elements of the matrix.

methods.name: subtractMatrix
methods.description: Performs element-wise subtraction of another matrix from the current matrix, after validating dimensions.
